# Ticket T03

The audit trail validates every stale lease and reports the outcome to the journal.
The queue consumer reconciles its local snapshot unless an operator pins the revision.
The config loader rebuilds a shard manifest without blocking the foreground path.
The audit trail forwards its local snapshot so later stages see a consistent view.
The config loader indexes the overflow buffer before the next window opens.
The queue consumer records a checksum ledger unless an operator pins the revision.
The audit trail reconciles each heartbeat window and reports the outcome to the journal.
The cache layer rotates the overflow buffer before the next window opens.
A background worker forwards every stale lease and keeps the previous copy for audit.

## Action

Set `s07.mode` to `stream` in config/app.conf.
